macos.detail: Experimental Sikarugir Wine + D9VK runs the original Windows game. Requires Apple Silicon, Rosetta 2 and macOS Tahoe 26+. Campaigns, graphics and Steam startup still need gameplay testing.
macos.prepare: Pinned Sikarugir Wine 11 + D9VK for the game and DXMT for Steam’s interface, in a separate runtime. Requires macOS Tahoe 26+; existing games keep their current requirements.
macos.play: Experimental C&C 3 support. First Play installs/opens Valve’s Windows Steam client in this Wine profile; sign in only in Steam’s window. Steam starts the game after authentication. First-time updates may take several minutes. Windowed mode uses 1280×720. Mods and C&C:Online are not installed yet.

linux.detail: Experimental Steam Proton support. Uses your native Linux Steam client, owned game and Steam-managed Proton. Flatpak Steam is not supported in this first integration.
linux.prepare: Open Steam setup, enable Proton 11 in this game’s Properties → Compatibility, install the English game and start it once. Return here to check readiness.
linux.play: Experimental Steam Proton support. Steam manages runtime updates, saves and its game copy. Launch display options are passed to Steam. Mods and C&C:Online are not installed yet.
